Riverland Regional Assessment Panel

			
        
    
                    


    



 
The Minister for Planning constituted the Riverland Regional Assessment Panel, incorporating the areas of Berri Barmera Council, the Renmark Paringa Council, and the District Council of Loxton Waikerie, pursuant to the Planning Development and Infrastructure Act 2016 (the PDI Act). The Regional Assessment Panel commenced operations on 31 July 2020.
The following people have been appointed as members of the Riverland Regional Assessment Panel, in accordance with a Service Agreement between the Councils:
  • Independent Presiding Member
     Mr Geoff Parsons
  • Independent Members:
     Ms Julie Lewis
     Mr Michael Doherty
     Mr Stephen Smith
    Mr Grant Hewitt (deputy member)
Cr Gary Pfeiler is the Elected Member appointed to the Panel until 31 December 2025, on behalf of the host, the District Council of Loxton Waikerie. Cr Clive Matthews has been appointed as the Deputy Council Member and may attend at times Cr Pfeiler is unavailable.
The Panel is a relevant authority for the purposes of Development Assessment in accordance with the PDI Act. The Panel in turn delegates some of its decision-making powers to the Regional Assessment Manager.
The Panel will adhere to the Code of Conduct for Assessment Panel Members, provided by Schedule 3 of the Planning, Development and Infrastructure Act, and adopts its own Meeting Procedures for the conduct of its members and for its meetings.   Codes of Conduct - Plan SA
The Agendas and Minutes of the Panel are available by selecting the links hereunder. Copies of the agenda and minutes are also available at the principal office, 5 Riverview Drive, Berri.
Archived minutes of the Panel, the superseded Berri Barmera Development Assessment Panel, which ceased operation at 31 December 2009, the superseded Riverland Regional Assessment Panel, which ceased operations on 30 September 2017, are available from the archived files below.
